combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Sailing & Boats × Winnie-the-Pooh

entries.clue: Fearsome tree-dweller of two friends' imagining, said to shout for help
Top edge of a small boat's side, gripped as you climb aboard
Boy's map version of the word for boulders, ending oddly with an X.
Twin-hulled craft that skims along flat instead of leaning over
Creamy-white root, sweeter than a carrot when its edges catch
Short for the dessert in the parental threat 'Eat your greens or there's no ___!'
Line you heave on hand over hand to raise a sail, then make fast
Great old sailing ships, oddly naming a magic circle of sixty-odd trees.
Insulated box in a cooker where the joint spends two hours or more
White river bird that carried the bear's short name before the bear did.
Wire led from high up to the bow to hold the whole rig from falling
Bramley, stewed with sugar into the sauce that goes with pork
Nursery minder blamed in a verse for letting a boy's pet beetle escape.
